page_note: 这是《Digital News Report 2022》第46页，左侧为2.4节正文，右侧一张无编号的横向条形图，展示42个市场上周通过邮件获取新闻的比例，并用橙色虚线标出17%的平均值。

heading.title: PROPORTION WHO ACCESSED NEWS VIA EMAIL IN THE LAST WEEK – SELECTED MARKETS

components.evidence: country names down the left axis, bars grow rightwards from a 0% baseline
white numbers 24, 23, 22 ... 9 printed at the right end inside each bar
orange dotted vertical rule crossing all bars at the 17% position, tick at top and bottom
dotted orange box in plot area: "17% Average shown across all 42 markets"
the USA bar is filled orange while all other 41 bars are teal
42 market names stacked down one axis, e.g. "Czech Republic", "Hong Kong", "South Korea"
small print below plot: "Q10. Thinking about how you got news online ... Base: Total sample in each market (n ≈ 2000)."
body prose column "In the last few years..." and "WEEKLY EMAIL CONSUMPTION" runs level with the chart

new_components.name: endpoint_only_value_axis
new_components.evidence: the value axis prints only "0%" and "25%" at the two ends, no intermediate ticks
new_components.why_it_matters: 没有中间刻度时，未打印的数值只能靠两端插值，读数精度完全依赖条内标签。

new_components.name: percent_sign_on_tick_only
new_components.evidence: axis ends read "0%" and "25%" while bar labels are bare numbers 24, 23, 22
new_components.why_it_matters: 单位只出现在刻度上，表格若只抄条内数字会丢掉百分号语义。

new_components.name: callout_annotates_reference_line
new_components.evidence: the dotted box "17% Average shown across all 42 markets" sits on and explains the orange 17% rule
new_components.why_it_matters: 17%这个值属于参考线而非任何条形，取值时须与42个国家行区分开。

new_components.name: unnumbered_figure_heading
new_components.evidence: heading is all-caps two lines with no "Figure" or "Exhibit" number anywhere
new_components.why_it_matters: 缺少编号意味着行标题只能靠标题文本定位，解析输出难以与正文交叉引用。

new_components.name: sorted_rank_order_rows
new_components.evidence: bars run monotonically 24 down to 9 from Austria to UK, not alphabetical
new_components.why_it_matters: 顺序本身承载排名信息，重复值（22、11）的行序需按图上顺序保留。

difficulty_notes: 所有42个数值都以白字印在条内，读数不需要对轴插值（轴上只有0%和25%两个刻度，若靠像素读数，1个百分点约等于5%容差的边界），所以第2步不是瓶颈；单系列单面板，一个国家名即可唯一定位，重复值22（USA/Portugal）和11（Croatia/Finland/Norway）也只需国家名一列，第3步同样不难。真正的风险是这张图完全是位图且没有图号，解析器要么整块跳过，要么把42行国家名与数字挤成一段无结构文本，那么24、22、11、9连带国家标签都无从检索。

suggestions.what_to_add: reference_line 与 annotation_callout 的组合（虚线参考线自带文字框说明其数值与含义）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图形样式条件行中新增“参考线+说明框”开关，记录里为参考线单独保存 value 与 label 字段
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有/无“参考线数值单独成行”的表格导出对比，检验17%这类非条形数值是否被误当作某国数据

suggestions.where_to_change: 轴刻度样式字段：tick 数量可降至2，并把单位符号只放在刻度而非标题
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 刻度密度（2刻度 vs 5刻度）× 是否打印条内数值，对可读精度的影响一行

suggestions.what_to_add: 42 类目的横向条形高密度排布（wrapped_category_labels 上限提高）
suggestions.where_to_change: 生成条件中类目数上限，以及横向条形的画布高度自适应
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 类目数 12 / 25 / 42 三档下行标签召回率一行

suggestions.what_to_add: unnumbered_figure_heading（图号为空、全大写两行标题）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题记录字段：figure_number 允许为空，title 支持换行且大写，placement=above
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有图号 vs 无图号时，标题作为粗体行随表导出的成功率一行

suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中新增“单类目强调色”，并在记录中标记该类目为 highlighted
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 强调色是否被误读成第二个系列的一行对比
